How far each quick turn goes.._: settings menu: the tip on the 'snap angle' row in the moving section; keep about as long as the English (the tip wraps to at most three lines of ~50 characters); plain, friendly sentences
How far each quick turn goes..ja: スナップ回転1回あたりの角度です。
How far each quick turn goes..tr: Her hızlı dönüşün ne kadar döndüğü.
How far each quick turn goes..fr: L'ampleur de chaque cran de rotation.
How far each quick turn goes..da: Hvor langt hvert hurtigt drej går.
How far each quick turn goes..pl: Jak duży jest każdy skok obrotu.
How far each quick turn goes..de: Wie weit jede schnelle Drehung geht.

The left stick walks you where you look,._: settings menu: the tip on the 'moving toward' row in the moving section; keep about as long as the English (the tip wraps to at most three lines of ~50 characters); plain, friendly sentences
The left stick walks you where you look,.zh: 左搖桿讓你朝視線方向走，或朝左手指的方向走。
The left stick walks you where you look,.it: Lo stick sinistro ti porta dove guardi o dove punta la mano sinistra.
The left stick walks you where you look,.es: El joystick izquierdo te lleva hacia donde miras o hacia donde apunta tu mano izquierda.
The left stick walks you where you look,.pt: O analógico esquerdo leva você para onde você olha, ou para onde a mão esquerda aponta.
The left stick walks you where you look,.ja: 左スティックで、視線の先か、左手が指す方向へ歩きます。
The left stick walks you where you look,.tr: Sol çubuk sizi baktığınız yöne ya da sol elinizin gösterdiği yöne yürütür.
The left stick walks you where you look,.fr: Le joystick gauche vous fait avancer là où vous regardez, ou là où pointe votre main gauche.
The left stick walks you where you look,.da: Venstre styrepind fører dig derhen, hvor du ser, eller hvor din venstre hånd peger.
The left stick walks you where you look,.ru: Левый стик ведёт вас туда, куда вы смотрите или куда указывает левая рука.
The left stick walks you where you look,.pl: Lewa gałka prowadzi cię tam, gdzie patrzysz, albo tam, gdzie wskazuje lewa ręka.
The left stick walks you where you look,.az: Sol çubuq sizi baxdığınız yerə və ya sol əlinizin göstərdiyi yerə aparır.
The left stick walks you where you look,.de: Der linke Stick bewegt Sie in Blickrichtung oder dorthin, wohin Ihre linke Hand zeigt.
The left stick walks you where you look,.zh-Hans: 左摇杆让你朝视线方向走，或朝左手指的方向走。

Server follows your avatar where the reg._: settings menu: the tip on the 'movement' row in the moving section; keep about as long as the English (the tip wraps to at most three lines of ~50 characters); plain, friendly sentences; 'Server' and 'Predicted' are this row's two options: use the same words as their translations
Server follows your avatar where the reg.zh: 「伺服器」跟隨地區放置化身的位置，會稍慢一拍。「預測」會立即移動你，再由地區修正。
Server follows your avatar where the reg.it: Server segue l'avatar dove lo mette la regione, con un attimo di ritardo. Previsto ti muove subito e lascia che la regione ti corregga.
Server follows your avatar where the reg.es: Servidor sigue a tu avatar donde la región lo pone, con un momento de retraso. Predicho te mueve al instante y deja que la región te corrija.
Server follows your avatar where the reg.pt: Servidor segue o seu avatar onde a região o coloca, um instante depois. Previsto move você na hora e deixa a região corrigir você.
Server follows your avatar where the reg.ja: 「サーバー」は、リージョンが置いた位置へ少し遅れてアバターを追います。「予測」はすぐに動かし、リージョンが補正します。
Server follows your avatar where the reg.tr: Sunucu, avatarınızı bölgenin koyduğu yerde bir an geriden izler. Tahminli sizi hemen hareket ettirir ve bölgenin düzeltmesine izin verir.
Server follows your avatar where the reg.fr: Serveur suit votre avatar là où la région le place, avec un léger retard. Prédit vous déplace aussitôt et laisse la région vous corriger.
Server follows your avatar where the reg.da: Server følger din avatar, hvor regionen placerer den, et øjeblik bagefter. Forudsagt flytter dig med det samme og lader regionen rette dig.
Server follows your avatar where the reg.ru: «Сервер»: аватар идёт туда, где его ставит регион, с небольшой задержкой. «Прогноз» двигает вас сразу и даёт региону поправить вас.
Server follows your avatar where the reg.pl: Serwer podąża za awatarem tam, gdzie stawia go region, z lekkim opóźnieniem. Predykcja rusza cię od razu, a region cię poprawia.
Server follows your avatar where the reg.az: Server: avatarınızı regionun qoyduğu yerdə, bir an gecikmə ilə izləyir. Proqnoz sizi dərhal hərəkət etdirir və regionun düzəltməsinə imkan verir.
Server follows your avatar where the reg.de: „Server“ folgt Ihrem Avatar dorthin, wo die Region ihn hinsetzt, einen Moment später. „Sofort“ bewegt Sie direkt und lässt die Region korrigieren.
Server follows your avatar where the reg.zh-Hans: “服务器”跟随地区放置化身的位置，会慢一拍。“预测”会立即移动你，再由地区校正。

When your avatar can't follow you, it's._: settings menu: the tip on the 'putting you back' row in the moving section; keep about as long as the English (the tip wraps to at most three lines of ~50 characters); plain, friendly sentences; the three ways are the row's options teleport, jump, slide
When your avatar can't follow you, it's.zh: 化身跟不上你時，會把它瞬間傳送到你身邊，或讓你的視野跳回或滑回它那裡。
When your avatar can't follow you, it's.it: Quando l'avatar non riesce a seguirti, viene teletrasportato da te, o la tua vista torna a lui con un salto o uno scivolo.
When your avatar can't follow you, it's.es: Cuando tu avatar no puede seguirte, se teleporta hasta ti, o tu vista salta o se desliza de vuelta hasta él.
When your avatar can't follow you, it's.pt: Quando o seu avatar não consegue seguir você, ele é teletransportado até você, ou a sua visão salta ou desliza de volta até ele.
When your avatar can't follow you, it's.ja: アバターがついて来られないとき、アバターをあなたの所へテレポートするか、視界をアバターへジャンプまたはスライドで戻します。
When your avatar can't follow you, it's.tr: Avatarınız sizi izleyemediğinde size ışınlanır ya da görüntünüz ona atlar veya kayarak geri döner.
When your avatar can't follow you, it's.fr: Quand votre avatar ne peut pas vous suivre, il est téléporté vers vous, ou votre vue saute ou glisse jusqu'à lui.
When your avatar can't follow you, it's.da: Når din avatar ikke kan følge med dig, teleporteres den til dig, eller din udsigt springer eller glider tilbage til den.
When your avatar can't follow you, it's.ru: Если аватар не может следовать за вами, он телепортируется к вам, или ваш взгляд скачком или плавно возвращается к нему.
When your avatar can't follow you, it's.pl: Gdy awatar nie nadąża, teleportuje się do ciebie albo widok wraca do niego skokiem lub ślizgiem.
When your avatar can't follow you, it's.az: Avatarınız sizə çata bilməyəndə ya o sizə teleport edilir, ya da görüntünüz ona sıçrayır və ya sürüşüb qayıdır.
When your avatar can't follow you, it's.de: Kann Ihr Avatar Ihnen nicht folgen, wird er zu Ihnen teleportiert, oder Ihre Sicht springt oder gleitet zu ihm zurück.
When your avatar can't follow you, it's.zh-Hans: 化身跟不上你时，会把它传送到你身边，或让你的视野跳回或滑回它那里。

Hold the left trigger on open ground to._: settings menu: the tip on the 'point to teleport' row in the moving section; keep about as long as the English (the tip wraps to at most three lines of ~50 characters); plain, friendly sentences; the left trigger: the Quest controller's
Hold the left trigger on open ground to.zh: 在空地上按住左扳機鍵，就能瞬間傳送過去。
Hold the left trigger on open ground to.it: Tieni premuto il trigger sinistro su un terreno libero per teletrasportarti lì.
Hold the left trigger on open ground to.es: Mantén el gatillo izquierdo sobre suelo despejado para teleportarte allí.
Hold the left trigger on open ground to.pt: Segure o gatilho esquerdo apontando para o chão livre para se teletransportar até lá.
Hold the left trigger on open ground to.ja: 開けた地面で左トリガーを押し続けると、そこへテレポートします。
Hold the left trigger on open ground to.tr: Oraya ışınlanmak için açık zemine doğru sol tetiği basılı tutun.
Hold the left trigger on open ground to.fr: Maintenez la gâchette gauche sur un sol dégagé pour vous y téléporter.
Hold the left trigger on open ground to.da: Hold venstre aftrækker på åben grund for at teleportere derhen.
Hold the left trigger on open ground to.ru: Удерживайте левый триггер на открытом месте, чтобы телепортироваться туда.
Hold the left trigger on open ground to.pl: Przytrzymaj lewy spust nad wolnym terenem, by się tam teleportować.
Hold the left trigger on open ground to.az: Açıq yerdə sol tətiyi saxlayın ki, ora teleport olasınız.
Hold the left trigger on open ground to.de: Zeigen Sie auf freien Boden und halten Sie den linken Trigger, um dorthin zu teleportieren.
Hold the left trigger on open ground to.zh-Hans: 在空地上按住左扳机键，就能传送过去。

Look around away from your avatar, which._: settings menu: the tip on the 'look around' row in the moving section; keep about as long as the English (the tip wraps to at most three lines of ~50 characters); plain, friendly sentences; Y: the Quest controller's button, keep as is
Look around away from your avatar, which.zh: 離開化身四處看看，化身留在原地。按住 Y 也能開始。
Look around away from your avatar, which.it: Guardati intorno lontano dall'avatar, che resta dov'è. Anche tenere premuto Y lo avvia.
Look around away from your avatar, which.es: Mira alrededor lejos de tu avatar, que se queda donde está. Mantener Y también lo activa.
Look around away from your avatar, which.pt: Olhe em volta longe do seu avatar, que fica onde está. Segurar Y também ativa isso.
Look around away from your avatar, which.ja: アバターをその場に残して、離れた所から見回します。Yの長押しでも始まります。
Look around away from your avatar, which.tr: Avatarınız yerinde kalırken ondan uzakta etrafa bakın. Y'yi basılı tutmak da bunu başlatır.
Look around away from your avatar, which.fr: Regardez autour de vous, loin de votre avatar, qui reste où il est. Maintenir Y le lance aussi.
Look around away from your avatar, which.da: Kig rundt væk fra din avatar, som bliver, hvor den er. Du kan også starte det ved at holde Y.
Look around away from your avatar, which.ru: Осматривайтесь вдали от аватара — он остаётся на месте. Удержание Y тоже включает этот режим.
Look around away from your avatar, which.pl: Rozglądaj się z dala od awatara, który zostaje na miejscu. Przytrzymanie Y też to włącza.
Look around away from your avatar, which.az: Avatarınızdan ayrı ətrafa baxın, o yerində qalır. Y-ni saxlamaq da bunu başladır.
Look around away from your avatar, which.de: Sich abseits Ihres Avatars umsehen, der bleibt, wo er ist. Y halten startet es auch.
Look around away from your avatar, which.zh-Hans: 离开化身四处看看，化身留在原地。按住 Y 也能开始。

Shows your avatar's body when you look d._: settings menu: the tip on the 'your body' row in the moving section; keep about as long as the English (the tip wraps to at most three lines of ~50 characters); plain, friendly sentences
Shows your avatar's body when you look d.zh: 低頭時顯示化身的身體。
Shows your avatar's body when you look d.it: Mostra il corpo del tuo avatar quando guardi in basso.
Shows your avatar's body when you look d.es: Muestra el cuerpo de tu avatar cuando miras hacia abajo.
Shows your avatar's body when you look d.pt: Mostra o corpo do seu avatar quando você olha para baixo.
Shows your avatar's body when you look d.ja: 下を見ると、自分のアバターの体が見えます。
Shows your avatar's body when you look d.fr: Montre le corps de votre avatar quand vous baissez les yeux.
Shows your avatar's body when you look d.da: Viser din avatars krop, når du kigger ned.
Shows your avatar's body when you look d.ru: Показывает тело аватара, когда вы смотрите вниз.
Shows your avatar's body when you look d.pl: Pokazuje ciało awatara, gdy patrzysz w dół.
Shows your avatar's body when you look d.de: Zeigt den Körper Ihres Avatars, wenn Sie nach unten sehen.
Shows your avatar's body when you look d.zh-Hans: 低头时显示化身的身体。

Your avatar's arms follow your hands. Au._: settings menu: the tip on the 'tracking' row in the moving section; keep about as long as the English (the tip wraps to at most three lines of ~50 characters); plain, friendly sentences; 'Auto' is the row's option: use the same word as its translation
Your avatar's arms follow your hands. Au.zh: 化身的手臂跟隨你的手。「自動」會讓周圍東西的舞蹈和姿勢接手。
Your avatar's arms follow your hands. Au.it: Le braccia dell'avatar seguono le tue mani. Con auto, balli e pose degli oggetti intorno prendono il sopravvento.
Your avatar's arms follow your hands. Au.es: Los brazos de tu avatar siguen a tus manos. Con auto, los bailes y poses de cosas a tu alrededor toman el control.
Your avatar's arms follow your hands. Au.pt: Os braços do seu avatar seguem as suas mãos. Auto deixa danças e poses das coisas ao redor assumirem.
Your avatar's arms follow your hands. Au.ja: アバターの腕があなたの手に合わせて動きます。「自動」では、周りの物のダンスやポーズが優先されます。
Your avatar's arms follow your hands. Au.tr: Avatarınızın kolları ellerinizi izler. Oto, çevrenizdeki şeylerden gelen dans ve pozların devralmasına izin verir.
Your avatar's arms follow your hands. Au.fr: Les bras de votre avatar suivent vos mains. Auto laisse les danses et poses des objets autour de vous prendre le relais.
Your avatar's arms follow your hands. Au.da: Din avatars arme følger dine hænder. Med auto kan danse og poser fra ting omkring dig tage over.
Your avatar's arms follow your hands. Au.ru: Руки аватара следуют за вашими. В режиме «авто» танцы и позы от окружающих вещей берут верх.
Your avatar's arms follow your hands. Au.pl: Ręce awatara podążają za twoimi dłońmi. Auto pozwala, by tańce i pozy z otoczenia przejęły kontrolę.
Your avatar's arms follow your hands. Au.az: Avatarınızın qolları əllərinizi izləyir. Avto rejimdə ətrafdakı əşyaların rəqs və pozaları idarəni ələ alır.
Your avatar's arms follow your hands. Au.de: Die Arme Ihres Avatars folgen Ihren Händen. Bei „auto“ übernehmen Tänze und Posen aus Ihrer Umgebung.
Your avatar's arms follow your hands. Au.zh-Hans: 化身的手臂跟随你的手。“自动”会让周围东西的舞蹈和姿势接管。

The ray from your right hand that touche._: settings menu: the tip on the 'pointer' row in the moving section; keep about as long as the English (the tip wraps to at most three lines of ~50 characters); plain, friendly sentences; A: the Quest controller's button, keep as is
The ray from your right hand that touche.zh: 從右手射出的光線，用來觸碰、坐下和按下。快按一下 A 可開關。
The ray from your right hand that touche.it: Il raggio della mano destra che tocca, siede e preme. Una pressione breve di A lo accende o lo spegne.
The ray from your right hand that touche.es: El rayo de tu mano derecha que toca, te sienta y pulsa. Una pulsación rápida de A lo activa o desactiva.
The ray from your right hand that touche.pt: O raio da sua mão direita que toca, senta e aperta. Um toque rápido no A liga ou desliga.
The ray from your right hand that touche.ja: 右手から出る光線で、触る、座る、押すことができます。Aを短く押すとオン・オフします。
The ray from your right hand that touche.tr: Sağ elinizden çıkan, dokunan, oturan ve basan ışın. A'ya kısa basış onu açar ya da kapatır.
The ray from your right hand that touche.fr: Le rayon de votre main droite qui touche, fait asseoir et appuie. Un appui bref sur A l'allume ou l'éteint.
The ray from your right hand that touche.da: Strålen fra din højre hånd, der berører, sætter dig og trykker. Et kort tryk på A slår den til eller fra.
The ray from your right hand that touche.ru: Луч из правой руки, который касается, сажает и нажимает. Короткое нажатие A включает и выключает его.
The ray from your right hand that touche.pl: Promień z prawej dłoni, który dotyka, sadza i naciska. Krótkie naciśnięcie A go włącza lub wyłącza.
The ray from your right hand that touche.az: Sağ əlinizdən çıxan, toxunan, oturan və basan şüa. A-nın qısa basışı onu açır və ya bağlayır.
The ray from your right hand that touche.de: Der Strahl aus Ihrer rechten Hand, der berührt, setzt und drückt. Kurz A drücken schaltet ihn an oder aus.
The ray from your right hand that touche.zh-Hans: 从右手射出的光线，用来触摸、坐下和按下。快按一下 A 可开关。

What others see of where you look: your._: settings menu: the tip on the 'your gaze' row in the moving section; keep about as long as the English (the tip wraps to at most three lines of ~50 characters); plain, friendly sentences
What others see of where you look: your.zh: 別人看到的你的視線：頭轉向你看著的人、只有方向，或什麼都沒有。
What others see of where you look: your.it: Cosa vedono gli altri di dove guardi: la testa che si gira verso chi guardi, solo la direzione, o niente.
What others see of where you look: your.es: Lo que los demás ven de adónde miras: tu cabeza girando hacia quien miras, solo la dirección, o nada.
What others see of where you look: your.pt: O que os outros veem de para onde você olha: a sua cabeça virando para quem você olha, só a direção, ou nada.
What others see of where you look: your.ja: あなたの視線が他の人にどう見えるか：見ている相手に頭を向ける、方向だけ、または何もなし。
What others see of where you look: your.tr: Baktığınız yerden başkalarının ne gördüğü: başınızın baktığınız kişiye dönmesi, yalnızca yön ya da hiçbir şey.
What others see of where you look: your.fr: Ce que les autres voient de votre regard : votre tête tournée vers qui vous regardez, la direction seule, ou rien.
What others see of where you look: your.da: Hvad andre ser af, hvor du kigger: dit hoved, der drejer mod den, du ser på, kun retningen eller intet.
What others see of where you look: your.ru: Что другие видят о вашем взгляде: голова поворачивается к тому, на кого вы смотрите, только направление или ничего.
What others see of where you look: your.pl: Co inni widzą z twojego spojrzenia: głowę zwróconą ku osobie, na którą patrzysz, sam kierunek albo nic.
What others see of where you look: your.az: Başqaları baxdığınız yeri necə görür: başınız baxdığınız adama dönür, yalnız istiqamət, ya da heç nə.
What others see of where you look: your.de: Was andere von Ihrem Blick sehen: Ihr Kopf dreht sich zu dem, den Sie ansehen, nur die Richtung, oder nichts.
What others see of where you look: your.zh-Hans: 别人看到的你的视线：头转向你看着的人、只有方向，或什么都没有。

Which model OpenRouter runs. Claude keep._: settings menu: the tip on the 'openrouter model' row in the assistant section; keep about as long as the English (the tip wraps to at most three lines of ~50 characters); plain, friendly sentences; OpenRouter and Claude are names, untranslated
Which model OpenRouter runs. Claude keep.zh: OpenRouter 執行哪個模型。選 Claude 會維持平常的模型；其他廠商的模型會自己回答一切，未必能做到 Claude 能做的所有事。供應商和金鑰在啟動器中設定。
Which model OpenRouter runs. Claude keep.it: Quale modello usa OpenRouter. Claude mantiene i soliti modelli; il modello di un altro produttore risponde da solo a tutto e potrebbe non fare tutto ciò che fa Claude. Provider e chiave si impostano nel launcher.
Which model OpenRouter runs. Claude keep.es: Qué modelo ejecuta OpenRouter. Claude mantiene los modelos de siempre; el modelo de otro fabricante lo responde todo él mismo y puede no hacer todo lo que hace Claude. El proveedor y su clave se ponen en el lanzador.
Which model OpenRouter runs. Claude keep.pt: Qual modelo o OpenRouter roda. Claude mantém os modelos de sempre; o modelo de outra empresa responde tudo sozinho e talvez não faça tudo o que o Claude faz. O provedor e a chave ficam no launcher.
Which model OpenRouter runs. Claude keep.ja: OpenRouterで動かすモデルです。Claudeなら通常のモデル構成のままです。他社のモデルはすべてを自分で答え、Claudeと同じことはできない場合があります。プロバイダーとキーはランチャーで設定します。
Which model OpenRouter runs. Claude keep.tr: OpenRouter'ın çalıştırdığı model. Claude olağan modelleri korur; başka bir üreticinin modeli her şeyi kendisi yanıtlar ve Claude'un yaptığı her şeyi yapamayabilir. Sağlayıcı ve anahtarı başlatıcıda ayarlanır.
Which model OpenRouter runs. Claude keep.fr: Le modèle qu'utilise OpenRouter. Claude garde les modèles habituels ; le modèle d'un autre fabricant répond seul à tout et ne fait peut-être pas tout ce que fait Claude. Le fournisseur et sa clé se règlent dans le lanceur.
Which model OpenRouter runs. Claude keep.da: Hvilken model OpenRouter kører. Claude beholder de sædvanlige modeller; en anden producents model svarer selv på alt og kan måske ikke alt, hvad Claude kan. Udbyderen og dens nøgle indstilles i startprogrammet.
Which model OpenRouter runs. Claude keep.ru: Какую модель запускает OpenRouter. С Claude остаются обычные модели; модель другого разработчика отвечает на всё сама и умеет не всё, что Claude. Провайдер и ключ задаются в лаунчере.
Which model OpenRouter runs. Claude keep.pl: Który model uruchamia OpenRouter. Claude zostaje przy zwykłych modelach; model innego twórcy sam odpowiada na wszystko i może nie umieć wszystkiego, co Claude. Dostawcę i klucz ustawia się w launcherze.

The assistant takes on the character you.zh-Hans: 助手会呈现你描述的性格。

The assistant waits for your press befor._: settings menu: the tip on the 'ask before touching others' things' row in the assistant section; keep about as long as the English (the tip wraps to at most three lines of ~50 characters); plain, friendly sentences
The assistant waits for your press befor.zh: 觸碰不屬於你的東西或回答它們的選單前，助理會等你按下確認。
The assistant waits for your press befor.it: L'assistente aspetta la tua conferma prima di toccare o rispondere ai menu di cose non tue.
The assistant waits for your press befor.es: El asistente espera a que pulses antes de tocar o responder menús de cosas que no son tuyas.
The assistant waits for your press befor.pt: O assistente espera o seu toque antes de tocar ou responder menus em coisas que não são suas.
The assistant waits for your press befor.ja: あなたの物でない物に触ったり、そのメニューに答えたりする前に、アシスタントはあなたが押すのを待ちます。
The assistant waits for your press befor.tr: Asistan, size ait olmayan şeylere dokunmadan ya da menülerini yanıtlamadan önce basmanızı bekler.
The assistant waits for your press befor.fr: L'assistant attend votre accord avant de toucher les objets qui ne sont pas à vous ou de répondre à leurs menus.
The assistant waits for your press befor.da: Assistenten venter på dit tryk, før den berører eller svarer på menuer på ting, der ikke er dine.
The assistant waits for your press befor.ru: Ассистент ждёт вашего нажатия, прежде чем трогать чужие вещи или отвечать на их меню.
The assistant waits for your press befor.pl: Asystent czeka na twoje naciśnięcie, zanim dotknie cudzej rzeczy lub odpowie na jej menu.
The assistant waits for your press befor.az: Köməkçi sizin olmayan əşyalara toxunmazdan və ya menyularına cavab verməzdən əvvəl sizin basmağınızı gözləyir.
The assistant waits for your press befor.de: Der Assistent wartet auf Ihren Druck, bevor er fremde Dinge berührt oder ihre Menüs beantwortet.
The assistant waits for your press befor.zh-Hans: 触摸不属于你的东西或回答它们的菜单前，助手会等你按下确认。

Shows every setting, for experienced Sec._: settings menu: the tip on the 'advanced menu' row in the assistant section; keep about as long as the English (the tip wraps to at most three lines of ~50 characters); plain, friendly sentences; Second Life stays untranslated
Shows every setting, for experienced Sec.zh: 顯示所有設定，適合有經驗的 Second Life 玩家。無論如何，只要你開口，助理都能變更任何設定。
Shows every setting, for experienced Sec.it: Mostra ogni impostazione, per chi conosce bene Second Life. In ogni caso, l'assistente può cambiarle tutte quando glielo chiedi.
Shows every setting, for experienced Sec.es: Muestra todos los ajustes, para quien ya conoce Second Life. En cualquier caso, el asistente puede cambiar cualquiera si se lo pides.
Shows every setting, for experienced Sec.pt: Mostra todas as configurações, para quem já tem experiência no Second Life. De todo jeito, o assistente pode mudar qualquer uma quando você pedir.
Shows every setting, for experienced Sec.ja: Second Lifeに慣れた人向けに、すべての設定を表示します。どちらの場合も、頼めばアシスタントがどの設定でも変更できます。
Shows every setting, for experienced Sec.tr: Deneyimli Second Life oyuncuları için tüm ayarları gösterir. Her iki durumda da asistan, siz isteyince herhangi birini değiştirebilir.
Shows every setting, for experienced Sec.fr: Affiche tous les réglages, pour les résidents expérimentés de Second Life. Dans tous les cas, l'assistant peut en changer n'importe lequel à votre demande.
Shows every setting, for experienced Sec.da: Viser alle indstillinger, til erfarne Second Life-spillere. Uanset hvad kan assistenten ændre dem alle, når du beder om det.
Shows every setting, for experienced Sec.ru: Показывает все настройки, для опытных игроков Second Life. В любом случае ассистент может изменить любую из них по вашей просьбе.
Shows every setting, for experienced Sec.pl: Pokazuje wszystkie ustawienia, dla doświadczonych graczy Second Life. Tak czy inaczej asystent zmieni każde z nich na twoją prośbę.
Shows every setting, for experienced Sec.az: Təcrübəli Second Life oyunçuları üçün bütün ayarları göstərir. Hər halda köməkçi istəyəndə onların istənilənini dəyişə bilər.
Shows every setting, for experienced Sec.de: Zeigt alle Einstellungen, für erfahrene Spieler von Second Life. So oder so kann der Assistent jede davon ändern, wenn Sie ihn bitten.
Shows every setting, for experienced Sec.zh-Hans: 显示所有设置，适合有经验的 Second Life 玩家。无论如何，只要你开口，助手都能更改任何设置。

Nothing from now on is kept, and the ass._: settings menu: the tip on the 'incognito' row in the incognito section; keep about as long as the English (the tip wraps to at most three lines of ~50 characters); plain, friendly sentences
Nothing from now on is kept, and the ass.zh: 從現在起不保留任何紀錄，助理只看到大致情況。只有你能結束它。
Nothing from now on is kept, and the ass.it: Da ora non si conserva nulla e l'assistente vede solo un quadro generale. Solo tu puoi terminarlo.
Nothing from now on is kept, and the ass.es: A partir de ahora no se guarda nada, y el asistente solo ve una idea general. Solo tú puedes terminarlo.
Nothing from now on is kept, and the ass.pt: Nada daqui em diante fica guardado, e o assistente só vê um quadro geral. Só você pode encerrar.
Nothing from now on is kept, and the ass.ja: 今から何も残さず、アシスタントには大まかな状況だけが見えます。終えられるのはあなただけです。
Nothing from now on is kept, and the ass.tr: Bundan sonrası saklanmaz ve asistan yalnızca genel bir resim görür. Yalnızca siz bitirebilirsiniz.
Nothing from now on is kept, and the ass.fr: Désormais rien n'est gardé, et l'assistant ne voit qu'une image générale. Personne d'autre que vous ne peut y mettre fin.
Nothing from now on is kept, and the ass.da: Intet fra nu af gemmes, og assistenten ser kun et overordnet billede. Kun du kan afslutte det.
Nothing from now on is kept, and the ass.ru: С этого момента ничего не сохраняется, а ассистент видит лишь общую картину. Выключить это можете только вы.
Nothing from now on is kept, and the ass.pl: Od teraz nic nie jest zapisywane, a asystent widzi tylko ogólny obraz. Tylko ty możesz to zakończyć.
Nothing from now on is kept, and the ass.az: İndidən heç nə saxlanılmır və köməkçi yalnız ümumi mənzərəni görür. Bunu yalnız siz bitirə bilərsiniz.
Nothing from now on is kept, and the ass.de: Ab jetzt wird nichts gespeichert, und der Assistent sieht nur ein grobes Bild. Nur Sie können das beenden.
Nothing from now on is kept, and the ass.zh-Hans: 从现在起什么都不保留，助手只看到大致情况。只有你能结束它。

During incognito the assistant sees and._: settings menu: the tip on the 'let the assistant see' row in the incognito section; keep about as long as the English (the tip wraps to at most three lines of ~50 characters); plain, friendly sentences
During incognito the assistant sees and.zh: 無痕期間，助理照常看見並協助你。仍然不保留任何紀錄。
During incognito the assistant sees and.it: Durante l'incognito l'assistente vede e aiuta come al solito. Comunque non si conserva nulla.
During incognito the assistant sees and.es: Durante el incógnito el asistente ve y ayuda como siempre. Aun así, no se guarda nada.
During incognito the assistant sees and.pt: Durante o incógnito o assistente vê e ajuda como sempre. Mesmo assim nada fica guardado.
During incognito the assistant sees and.ja: シークレット中も、アシスタントはいつも通り見て手伝います。それでも何も残しません。
During incognito the assistant sees and.tr: Gizli modda asistan her zamanki gibi görür ve yardım eder. Yine de hiçbir şey saklanmaz.
During incognito the assistant sees and.fr: En incognito, l'assistant voit et aide comme d'habitude. Rien n'est gardé pour autant.
During incognito the assistant sees and.da: Under inkognito ser og hjælper assistenten som normalt. Stadig gemmes intet.
During incognito the assistant sees and.ru: В режиме инкогнито ассистент видит и помогает как обычно. Но ничего по-прежнему не сохраняется.
During incognito the assistant sees and.pl: W trybie incognito asystent widzi i pomaga jak zwykle. Nadal nic nie jest zapisywane.
During incognito the assistant sees and.az: İnkoqnito zamanı köməkçi həmişəki kimi görür və kömək edir. Yenə də heç nə saxlanılmır.
During incognito the assistant sees and.de: Im Inkognito-Modus sieht und hilft der Assistent wie gewohnt. Gespeichert wird trotzdem nichts.
During incognito the assistant sees and.zh-Hans: 无痕期间，助手照常看见并帮忙。仍然什么都不保留。

Incognito comes on by itself whenever yo._: settings menu: the tip on the 'always here' row in the incognito section; keep about as long as the English (the tip wraps to at most three lines of ~50 characters); plain, friendly sentences
Incognito comes on by itself whenever yo.zh: 只要你在這塊土地上，無痕模式就會自動開啟。
Incognito comes on by itself whenever yo.it: L'incognito si attiva da solo ogni volta che sei su questo terreno.
Incognito comes on by itself whenever yo.es: El incógnito se activa solo siempre que estés en este terreno.
Incognito comes on by itself whenever yo.pt: O incógnito liga sozinho sempre que você estiver neste terreno.
Incognito comes on by itself whenever yo.ja: この土地にいるときは、シークレットが自動でオンになります。
Incognito comes on by itself whenever yo.tr: Bu arazide olduğunuz her an gizli mod kendiliğinden açılır.
Incognito comes on by itself whenever yo.fr: L'incognito s'active tout seul dès que vous êtes sur ce terrain.
Incognito comes on by itself whenever yo.da: Inkognito slås automatisk til, når du er på dette land.
Incognito comes on by itself whenever yo.ru: Инкогнито включается само, когда вы на этой земле.
Incognito comes on by itself whenever yo.pl: Incognito włącza się samo, ilekroć jesteś na tej działce.
Incognito comes on by itself whenever yo.az: Bu torpaqda olduğunuz hər an inkoqnito öz-özünə açılır.
Incognito comes on by itself whenever yo.de: Inkognito geht von selbst an, wann immer Sie auf diesem Land sind.
Incognito comes on by itself whenever yo.zh-Hans: 只要你在这块土地上，无痕模式就会自动开启。

Incognito comes on by itself at this pla._: settings menu: the tip on rows labelled 'always at …' (… a name or count) in the incognito section; keep about as long as the English (the tip wraps to at most three lines of ~50 characters); plain, friendly sentences; 'Off' means turning the row's switch off
Incognito comes on by itself at this pla.zh: 在這個地點，無痕模式會自動開啟。關掉就會把這個地點從清單移除。
Incognito comes on by itself at this pla.it: L'incognito si attiva da solo in questo luogo. Disattivandolo, il luogo esce dalla lista.
Incognito comes on by itself at this pla.es: El incógnito se activa solo en este lugar. Al desactivarlo, el lugar sale de la lista.
Incognito comes on by itself at this pla.pt: O incógnito liga sozinho neste lugar. Desligar tira o lugar da lista.
Incognito comes on by itself at this pla.ja: この場所では、シークレットが自動でオンになります。オフにするとリストから外れます。
Incognito comes on by itself at this pla.tr: Bu yerde gizli mod kendiliğinden açılır. Kapatmak yeri listeden çıkarır.
Incognito comes on by itself at this pla.fr: L'incognito s'active tout seul à cet endroit. Sur « non », l'endroit sort de la liste.
Incognito comes on by itself at this pla.da: Inkognito slås automatisk til på dette sted. Fra fjerner stedet fra listen.
Incognito comes on by itself at this pla.ru: Инкогнито включается само в этом месте. Выключите, чтобы убрать место из списка.
Incognito comes on by itself at this pla.pl: Incognito włącza się samo w tym miejscu. Wyłączenie usuwa miejsce z listy.
Incognito comes on by itself at this pla.az: Bu yerdə inkoqnito öz-özünə açılır. Açarı bağlasanız, yer siyahıdan çıxır.
Incognito comes on by itself at this pla.de: Inkognito geht an diesem Ort von selbst an. Aus nimmt den Ort von der Liste.
Incognito comes on by itself at this pla.zh-Hans: 在这个地点，无痕模式会自动开启。关掉就会把这个地点移出清单。

Incognito comes on by itself when this p._: settings menu: the tip on rows labelled 'always with …' (… a name or count) in the incognito section; keep about as long as the English (the tip wraps to at most three lines of ~50 characters); plain, friendly sentences
Incognito comes on by itself when this p.zh: 這個人在附近時，無痕模式會自動開啟。
Incognito comes on by itself when this p.it: L'incognito si attiva da solo quando questa persona è vicina.
Incognito comes on by itself when this p.es: El incógnito se activa solo cuando esta persona está cerca.
Incognito comes on by itself when this p.pt: O incógnito liga sozinho quando esta pessoa está perto.
Incognito comes on by itself when this p.ja: この人が近くにいるときは、シークレットが自動でオンになります。
Incognito comes on by itself when this p.tr: Bu kişi yakındayken gizli mod kendiliğinden açılır.
Incognito comes on by itself when this p.fr: L'incognito s'active tout seul quand cette personne est proche.
Incognito comes on by itself when this p.da: Inkognito slås automatisk til, når denne person er i nærheden.
Incognito comes on by itself when this p.ru: Инкогнито включается само, когда этот человек рядом.
Incognito comes on by itself when this p.pl: Incognito włącza się samo, gdy ta osoba jest w pobliżu.
Incognito comes on by itself when this p.az: Bu adam yaxında olanda inkoqnito öz-özünə açılır.
Incognito comes on by itself when this p.de: Inkognito geht von selbst an, wenn diese Person in der Nähe ist.
Incognito comes on by itself when this p.zh-Hans: 这个人在附近时，无痕模式会自动开启。

Incognito is on while a private conversa._: settings menu: the tip on the 'while an IM is open' row in the incognito section; keep about as long as the English (the tip wraps to at most three lines of ~50 characters); plain, friendly sentences
Incognito is on while a private conversa.zh: 私人對話開著時，無痕模式會開啟。
Incognito is on while a private conversa.it: L'incognito è attivo finché è aperta una conversazione privata.
Incognito is on while a private conversa.es: El incógnito está activo mientras haya una conversación privada abierta.
Incognito is on while a private conversa.pt: O incógnito fica ligado enquanto uma conversa privada estiver aberta.
Incognito is on while a private conversa.ja: プライベートな会話を開いている間は、シークレットがオンになります。
Incognito is on while a private conversa.tr: Özel bir sohbet açıkken gizli mod açıktır.
Incognito is on while a private conversa.fr: L'incognito est actif tant qu'une conversation privée est ouverte.
Incognito is on while a private conversa.da: Inkognito er slået til, mens en privat samtale er åben.
Incognito is on while a private conversa.ru: Инкогнито включено, пока открыт личный разговор.
Incognito is on while a private conversa.pl: Incognito jest włączone, gdy otwarta jest prywatna rozmowa.
Incognito is on while a private conversa.az: Şəxsi söhbət açıq olduğu müddətdə inkoqnito açıqdır.
Incognito is on while a private conversa.de: Inkognito ist an, solange ein privates Gespräch offen ist.
Incognito is on while a private conversa.zh-Hans: 私密对话打开时，无痕模式开启。

Others see you as busy. Messages wait fo._: settings menu: the tip on the 'do not disturb' row in the you section; keep about as long as the English (the tip wraps to at most three lines of ~50 characters); plain, friendly sentences; Do Not Disturb: SL's busy status, use the official viewer's term
Others see you as busy. Messages wait fo.zh: 別人會看到你正在忙。訊息會等你處理，每位傳訊息給你的人會收到一次你的回覆。
Others see you as busy. Messages wait fo.it: Gli altri ti vedono occupato. I messaggi ti aspettano e chi ti scrive riceve la tua risposta una volta.
Others see you as busy. Messages wait fo.es: Los demás te ven como ocupado. Los mensajes te esperan, y quien te escribe recibe tu respuesta una vez.
Others see you as busy. Messages wait fo.pt: Os outros veem você como ocupado. As mensagens esperam por você, e cada pessoa que escreve recebe a sua resposta uma vez.
Others see you as busy. Messages wait fo.ja: 他の人には取り込み中に見えます。メッセージは届いて待っており、送ってきた人それぞれにあなたの返信が一度だけ送られます。
Others see you as busy. Messages wait fo.tr: Başkaları sizi meşgul görür. İletiler sizi bekler ve yazan her kişi yanıtınızı bir kez alır.
Others see you as busy. Messages wait fo.fr: Les autres vous voient comme indisponible. Les messages vous attendent, et chaque personne qui écrit reçoit une fois votre réponse.
Others see you as busy. Messages wait fo.da: Andre ser dig som optaget. Beskeder venter på dig, og hver person, der skriver, får dit svar én gang.
Others see you as busy. Messages wait fo.ru: Другие видят, что вы заняты. Сообщения ждут вас, а каждый написавший один раз получит ваш ответ.
Others see you as busy. Messages wait fo.pl: Inni widzą twój tryb Nie przeszkadzać. Wiadomości czekają, a każdy, kto napisze, raz dostaje twoją odpowiedź.
Others see you as busy. Messages wait fo.az: Başqaları sizi məşğul görür. Mesajlar sizi gözləyir, yazan hər kəs cavabınızı bir dəfə alır.
Others see you as busy. Messages wait fo.de: Andere sehen Sie als beschäftigt. Nachrichten warten auf Sie, und wer schreibt, bekommt einmal Ihre Antwort.
Others see you as busy. Messages wait fo.zh-Hans: 别人会看到你在忙。消息会等着你，每个给你发消息的人会收到一次你的回复。

Shows you to others as away.._: settings menu: the tip on the 'away' row in the you section; keep about as long as the English (the tip wraps to at most three lines of ~50 characters); plain, friendly sentences
Shows you to others as away..zh: 讓別人看到你處於離開狀態。
Shows you to others as away..it: Ti mostra agli altri come assente.
Shows you to others as away..es: Te muestra a los demás como ausente.
Shows you to others as away..pt: Mostra você aos outros como ausente.
Shows you to others as away..ja: 他の人に退席中と表示します。
Shows you to others as away..fr: Affiche aux autres votre statut absent.
Shows you to others as away..da: Viser dig som væk for andre.
Shows you to others as away..ru: Показывает другим, что вас нет на месте.
Shows you to others as away..zh-Hans: 让别人看到你处于离开状态。

How long without you before you show as._: settings menu: the tip on the 'away after' row in the you section; keep about as long as the English (the tip wraps to at most three lines of ~50 characters); plain, friendly sentences
How long without you before you show as.zh: 你不在多久之後自動顯示為離開。
How long without you before you show as.it: Quanto tempo senza di te prima che risulti assente da solo.
How long without you before you show as.es: Cuánto tiempo sin ti antes de mostrarte como ausente por sí solo.
How long without you before you show as.pt: Quanto tempo sem você antes de aparecer como ausente automaticamente.
How long without you before you show as.ja: どのくらい操作がないと、自動で退席中になるか。
How long without you before you show as.tr: Siz yokken ne kadar sonra kendiliğinden uzakta görüneceğiniz.
How long without you before you show as.fr: Le délai sans vous avant que votre statut passe tout seul à absent.
How long without you before you show as.da: Hvor længe du kan være fraværende, før du automatisk vises som væk.
How long without you before you show as.ru: Через сколько времени без вас статус «нет на месте» включится сам.
How long without you before you show as.pl: Po jakim czasie bez ciebie automatycznie pojawia się nieobecność.
How long without you before you show as.az: Siz olmadan nə qədər keçəndən sonra öz-özünə uzaqda görünəcəksiniz.
How long without you before you show as.de: Wie lange ohne Sie, bis Sie von selbst als abwesend erscheinen.
How long without you before you show as.zh-Hans: 你不在多久之后自动显示为离开。

Raises or lowers your avatar so its feet._: settings menu: the tip on the 'hover height' row in the you section; keep about as long as the English (the tip wraps to at most three lines of ~50 characters); plain, friendly sentences
Raises or lowers your avatar so its feet.zh: 升高或降低化身，讓雙腳貼齊地面。

Raises or lowers your avatar so its feet.es: Sube o baja tu avatar para que sus pies toquen el suelo.
Raises or lowers your avatar so its feet.pt: Sobe ou desce o seu avatar para os pés encostarem no chão.
Raises or lowers your avatar so its feet.ja: アバターを上げ下げして、足が床に合うようにします。
Raises or lowers your avatar so its feet.tr: Avatarınızı ayakları zemine değsin diye yükseltir ya da alçaltır.
Raises or lowers your avatar so its feet.fr: Monte ou descend votre avatar pour que ses pieds touchent le sol.
Raises or lowers your avatar so its feet.da: Hæver eller sænker din avatar, så fødderne rører gulvet.
Raises or lowers your avatar so its feet.ru: Поднимает или опускает аватар, чтобы ноги касались пола.
Raises or lowers your avatar so its feet.pl: Podnosi lub obniża awatara, by stopy dotykały podłogi.
Raises or lowers your avatar so its feet.az: Avatarınızı qaldırır və ya endirir ki, ayaqları yerə dəysin.
Raises or lowers your avatar so its feet.de: Hebt oder senkt Ihren Avatar, damit seine Füße den Boden berühren.
Raises or lowers your avatar so its feet.zh-Hans: 升高或降低化身，让双脚贴合地面。

Others see when you're typing.._: settings menu: the tip on the 'show typing' row in the you section; keep about as long as the English (the tip wraps to at most three lines of ~50 characters); plain, friendly sentences
Others see when you're typing..zh: 別人會看到你正在輸入。
Others see when you're typing..it: Gli altri vedono quando stai scrivendo.
Others see when you're typing..es: Los demás ven cuándo estás escribiendo.
Others see when you're typing..pt: Os outros veem quando você está digitando.
Others see when you're typing..ja: 入力中であることが他の人に見えます。
Others see when you're typing..fr: Les autres voient quand vous écrivez.
Others see when you're typing..da: Andre kan se, når du skriver.
Others see when you're typing..zh-Hans: 别人会看到你正在输入。

Who can message, call, befriend, invite._: settings menu: the tip on the 'turn away' group row (it opens a page of rows) in the you section; keep about as long as the English (the tip wraps to at most three lines of ~50 characters); plain, friendly sentences

Whose web pages and videos your first cl.az: İlk klikiniz obyektə yox, kimin veb səhifə və videolarına gedir.

Whose web pages and videos your first cl.zh-Hans: 你的第一次点击交给谁的网页和视频，而不是交给物体本身。

Clicking a web page or video brings it u.es: Pulsar una página web o un vídeo lo acerca a ti.
Clicking a web page or video brings it u.pt: Clicar em uma página web ou vídeo traz para perto.
Clicking a web page or video brings it u.ja: Webページや動画をクリックすると、近くに寄せて表示します。

Clicking a web page or video brings it u.fr: Cliquer sur une page web ou une vidéo la rapproche de vous.
Clicking a web page or video brings it u.da: Et klik på en webside eller video henter den tæt på.
Clicking a web page or video brings it u.ru: Щелчок по веб-странице или видео приближает их к вам.
Clicking a web page or video brings it u.pl: Kliknięcie strony lub filmu przybliża go do ciebie.

Clicking a web page or video brings it u.de: Ein Klick auf eine Webseite oder ein Video holt es nah heran.
Clicking a web page or video brings it u.zh-Hans: 点击网页或视频时会把它拉到眼前。

What arrives is read out through your sc._: settings menu: the tip on the 'read out' row in the screen reader section; keep about as long as the English (the tip wraps to at most three lines of ~50 characters); plain, friendly sentences; 'Auto' is the row's option: use the same word as its translation
What arrives is read out through your sc.zh: 收到的內容會透過你的螢幕閱讀器朗讀。「自動」會在有螢幕閱讀器執行時朗讀。
What arrives is read out through your sc.it: Ciò che arriva viene letto dal tuo screen reader. Con auto, lo fa ogni volta che ce n'è uno attivo.
What arrives is read out through your sc.es: Lo que llega se lee con tu lector de pantalla. Con auto, se hace siempre que haya uno en marcha.
What arrives is read out through your sc.pt: O que chega é lido pelo seu leitor de tela. Auto faz isso sempre que houver um ativo.
What arrives is read out through your sc.ja: 届いたものをスクリーンリーダーで読み上げます。「自動」では、スクリーンリーダーが動いているときに読み上げます。
What arrives is read out through your sc.tr: Gelenler ekran okuyucunuz aracılığıyla sesli okunur. Oto, bir ekran okuyucu çalıştığı sürece bunu yapar.
What arrives is read out through your sc.fr: Ce qui arrive est lu par votre lecteur d'écran. Auto le fait dès qu'il y en a un actif.
What arrives is read out through your sc.da: Det, der kommer ind, læses op via din skærmlæser. Auto gør det, når en kører.
What arrives is read out through your sc.ru: Всё приходящее зачитывается через ваш скринридер. «Авто» делает это, когда он запущен.
What arrives is read out through your sc.pl: To, co przychodzi, czyta twój czytnik ekranu. Auto robi to zawsze, gdy jakiś działa.
What arrives is read out through your sc.az: Gələnlər ekran oxuyucunuzla oxunur. Avto: biri işləyəndə həmişə oxunur.
What arrives is read out through your sc.de: Was ankommt, wird über Ihren Screenreader vorgelesen. „auto“ tut das, sobald einer läuft.
What arrives is read out through your sc.zh-Hans: 收到的内容会通过你的读屏软件读出。“自动”会在有读屏软件运行时读出。

Read out offers, menus, invitations and._: settings menu: the tip on the 'notices' row in the screen reader section; keep about as long as the English (the tip wraps to at most three lines of ~50 characters); plain, friendly sentences
Read out offers, menus, invitations and.zh: 朗讀邀請、選單、邀約和提醒。

Read out the assistant's replies.._: settings menu: the tip on the 'the assistant' row in the screen reader section; keep about as long as the English (the tip wraps to at most three lines of ~50 characters); plain, friendly sentences

Read out each song's title as the music._: settings menu: the tip on the 'music titles' row in the screen reader section; keep about as long as the English (the tip wraps to at most three lines of ~50 characters); plain, friendly sentences
Read out each song's title as the music.it: Leggi il titolo di ogni brano quando cambia la musica.
Read out each song's title as the music.es: Leer en voz alta el título de cada canción cuando cambia la música.

The edges of the view darken while you m._: settings menu: the tip on the 'comfort vignette' row in the safety section; keep about as long as the English (the tip wraps to at most three lines of ~50 characters); plain, friendly sentences
The edges of the view darken while you m.zh: 移動時視野邊緣變暗：永不、只在被其他東西移動時，或一律。
The edges of the view darken while you m.it: I bordi della vista si scuriscono mentre ti muovi: mai, solo quando qualcos'altro ti muove, o sempre.

The edges of the view darken while you m.pt: As bordas da visão escurecem enquanto você se move: nunca, só quando outra coisa move você, ou sempre.
The edges of the view darken while you m.ja: 移動中に視界の端を暗くします：しない、他から動かされたときだけ、常に。

The edges of the view darken while you m.fr: Les bords de la vue s'assombrissent quand vous bougez : jamais, seulement quand autre chose vous déplace, ou toujours.
The edges of the view darken while you m.da: Kanterne af udsynet bliver mørkere, mens du bevæger dig: aldrig, kun når noget andet flytter dig, eller altid.
The edges of the view darken while you m.ru: Края обзора темнеют при движении: никогда, только когда вас двигает что-то другое, или всегда.
The edges of the view darken while you m.pl: Brzegi widoku ciemnieją podczas ruchu: nigdy, tylko gdy porusza cię coś innego, albo zawsze.
The edges of the view darken while you m.az: Hərəkət edərkən görüntünün kənarları qaralır: heç vaxt, yalnız sizi başqa şey hərəkət etdirəndə, ya da həmişə.
The edges of the view darken while you m.de: Die Ränder der Sicht werden beim Bewegen dunkel: nie, nur wenn etwas anderes Sie bewegt, oder immer.
The edges of the view darken while you m.zh-Hans: 移动时视野边缘变暗：从不、只在被别的东西移动时，或总是。

When something pushes you away, you're p._: settings menu: the tip on the 'keep me in place' row in the safety section; keep about as long as the English (the tip wraps to at most three lines of ~50 characters); plain, friendly sentences

Takes back the controls a script has tak.da: Tager den styring tilbage, et script har overtaget, f.eks. din bevægelse.
Takes back the controls a script has tak.ru: Возвращает управление, которое перехватил скрипт, например движение.

Brings every menu you've moved back in f._: settings menu: the tip on the 'menu positions' row in the view section; keep about as long as the English (the tip wraps to at most three lines of ~50 characters); plain, friendly sentences

The language of Sojourn's menus and its._: settings menu: the tip on the 'language' row in the view section; keep about as long as the English (the tip wraps to at most three lines of ~50 characters); plain, friendly sentences; 'As Windows' is the row's first value: use the same words as its translation; Sojourn is a name, untranslated
The language of Sojourn's menus and its.zh: Sojourn 選單和它自己文字的語言。「跟隨 Windows」會使用電腦的顯示語言。

The language of Sojourn's menus and its.pt: O idioma dos menus e das palavras do Sojourn. Como o Windows segue o idioma de exibição do seu PC.
The language of Sojourn's menus and its.ja: Sojournのメニューと表示する言葉の言語。「Windowsに従う」はPCの表示言語に合わせます。
The language of Sojourn's menus and its.tr: Sojourn'un menülerinin ve kendi sözlerinin dili. Windows'taki gibi, bilgisayarınızın görüntüleme dilini izler.
The language of Sojourn's menus and its.fr: La langue des menus de Sojourn et de ses propres mots. Comme Windows suit la langue d'affichage de votre PC.
The language of Sojourn's menus and its.da: Sproget i Sojourns menuer og dens egne ord. Som Windows følger din pc's visningssprog.

The language of Sojourn's menus and its.pl: Język menu i tekstów Sojourn. Jak Windows oznacza język wyświetlania twojego PC.
The language of Sojourn's menus and its.az: Sojourn menyularının və öz sözlərinin dili. Windows kimi: kompüterinizin interfeys dilini izləyir.
The language of Sojourn's menus and its.de: Die Sprache der Menüs und Texte von Sojourn. „wie Windows“ folgt der Anzeigesprache Ihres PCs.
The language of Sojourn's menus and its.zh-Hans: Sojourn 菜单和它自己文字的语言。“跟随 Windows”会使用电脑的显示语言。

How far you can see. Further shows more,._: settings menu: the tip on the 'draw distance' row in the view section; keep about as long as the English (the tip wraps to at most three lines of ~50 characters); plain, friendly sentences
How far you can see. Further shows more,.zh: 你能看多遠。越遠看到越多，但載入也越多，可能會變慢。
How far you can see. Further shows more,.it: Quanto lontano vedi. Più lontano mostra di più, ma carica di più e può rallentare.
How far you can see. Further shows more,.es: Hasta dónde ves. Más lejos muestra más, pero carga más y puede ir más lento.
How far you can see. Further shows more,.pt: Até onde você enxerga. Mais longe mostra mais, mas carrega mais e pode deixar tudo lento.
How far you can see. Further shows more,.ja: どこまで見えるか。遠くするほど多く見えますが、読み込みが増えて重くなることがあります。
How far you can see. Further shows more,.tr: Ne kadar uzağı görebildiğiniz. Daha uzak daha çok gösterir ama daha çok yükler ve işleri yavaşlatabilir.
How far you can see. Further shows more,.fr: Jusqu'où vous voyez. Plus loin montre davantage, mais charge plus et peut tout ralentir.
How far you can see. Further shows more,.da: Hvor langt du kan se. Længere viser mere, men indlæser mere og kan gøre tingene langsommere.
How far you can see. Further shows more,.ru: Как далеко вы видите. Дальше — видно больше, но и загружается больше, и всё может тормозить.

How far you can see. Further shows more,.zh-Hans: 你能看多远。越远看到越多，但加载也越多，可能会变慢。

Light, balanced or full: shadows, reflec._: settings menu: the tip on the 'quality' row in the view section; keep about as long as the English (the tip wraps to at most three lines of ~50 characters); plain, friendly sentences; Light, balanced, full and Yours are the row's options: use the same words as their translations
Light, balanced or full: shadows, reflec.zh: 輕量、平衡或完整：一次設定陰影、反射、細節和距離，與啟動器相同。自訂：手動調整過。
Light, balanced or full: shadows, reflec.it: Leggera, bilanciata o piena: ombre, riflessi, dettaglio e distanza insieme, come nel launcher. Personale: cambiata a mano.
Light, balanced or full: shadows, reflec.es: Ligera, equilibrada o total: sombras, reflejos, detalle y distancia ajustados juntos, como en el lanzador. Lo tuyo: cambiado a mano.
Light, balanced or full: shadows, reflec.pt: Leve, médio ou total: sombras, reflexos, detalhe e distância ajustados juntos, como no launcher. Seus: mudados à mão.
Light, balanced or full: shadows, reflec.ja: 「軽量」「バランス」「フル」：影、反射、詳細度、距離をランチャーと同じようにまとめて設定します。「自分の」：手動で変更した状態。
Light, balanced or full: shadows, reflec.tr: Hafif, dengeli ya da tam: gölgeler, yansımalar, ayrıntı ve mesafe başlatıcıdaki gibi birlikte ayarlanır. Sizinki: elle değiştirilmiş.
Light, balanced or full: shadows, reflec.fr: Léger, équilibré ou complet : ombres, reflets, détail et distance réglés ensemble, comme dans le lanceur. À vous : réglé à la main.
Light, balanced or full: shadows, reflec.da: Let, middel eller fuld: skygger, refleksioner, detaljer og afstand indstillet samlet, som i startprogrammet. Egne: ændret i hånden.
Light, balanced or full: shadows, reflec.ru: Лёгкий, баланс или полный: тени, отражения, детализация и дальность настраиваются вместе, как в лаунчере. Свои: изменено вручную.
Light, balanced or full: shadows, reflec.pl: Lekka, średnia lub pełna: cienie, odbicia, szczegóły i odległość ustawione razem, jak w launcherze. Własne: zmienione ręcznie.
Light, balanced or full: shadows, reflec.az: Yüngül, balanslı və ya tam: kölgə, əks, detal və məsafə birlikdə, başladıcıdakı kimi. Sizinki: əllə dəyişdirilib.
Light, balanced or full: shadows, reflec.de: Leicht, mittel oder voll: Schatten, Reflexionen, Detail und Weite zusammen, wie im Launcher. Eigene: von Hand geändert.
Light, balanced or full: shadows, reflec.zh-Hans: 轻量、均衡或完整：一次设定阴影、反射、细节和距离，和启动器里一样。自定义：手动改过。

Shiny surfaces reflect what's around the._: settings menu: the tip on the 'reflections' row in the 'graphics' group of the view section; keep about as long as the English (the tip wraps to at most three lines of ~50 characters); plain, friendly sentences; 'Off' means the row's switch off

Shiny surfaces reflect what's around the.da: Blanke overflader spejler det, der er omkring dem. Med fra spejler de kun himlen.
Shiny surfaces reflect what's around the.ru: Блестящие поверхности отражают окружение. Если выключить, они отражают только небо.
Shiny surfaces reflect what's around the.pl: Błyszczące powierzchnie odbijają otoczenie. Wył.: odbijają tylko niebo.
Shiny surfaces reflect what's around the.az: Parlaq səthlər ətrafdakını əks etdirir. Bağlı olanda yalnız səmanı əks etdirir.
Shiny surfaces reflect what's around the.de: Glänzende Flächen spiegeln ihre Umgebung. Bei Aus spiegeln sie nur den Himmel.
Shiny surfaces reflect what's around the.zh-Hans: 光亮的表面会反射周围的东西。关掉时只反射天空。

Mirrors people have built show reflectio._: settings menu: the tip on the 'mirrors' row in the 'graphics' group of the view section; keep about as long as the English (the tip wraps to at most three lines of ~50 characters); plain, friendly sentences

Old-style hair, skirts, flags and plants._: settings menu: the tip on the 'flexible prims' row in the 'graphics' group of the view section; keep about as long as the English (the tip wraps to at most three lines of ~50 characters); plain, friendly sentences; 'Off' means the row's switch off; flexible prims: SL's flexi prims

Old-style hair, skirts, flags and plants.pt: Cabelos, saias, bandeiras e plantas à moda antiga balançam e caem. Desligado, ficam parados.

Old-style hair, skirts, flags and plants.pl: Starego typu włosy, spódnice, flagi i rośliny kołyszą się i zwisają. Wył.: stoją nieruchomo.
Old-style hair, skirts, flags and plants.az: Köhnə üslubda saç, ətək, bayraq və bitkilər yellənir və sallanır. Bağlı olanda hərəkətsiz qalır.
Old-style hair, skirts, flags and plants.de: Haare, Röcke, Fahnen und Pflanzen alter Art schwingen und hängen. Bei Aus bleiben sie starr.
Old-style hair, skirts, flags and plants.zh-Hans: 旧式的头发、裙子、旗子和植物会摆动、下垂。关掉时保持静止。

How far away things keep their full shap._: settings menu: the tip on the 'detail' row in the 'graphics' group of the view section; keep about as long as the English (the tip wraps to at most three lines of ~50 characters); plain, friendly sentences
How far away things keep their full shap.zh: 多遠的東西還能保持完整形狀。越高越好看，也越吃效能。
How far away things keep their full shap.it: Fino a che distanza le cose mantengono la forma piena. Più alto è più bello e costa di più.
How far away things keep their full shap.es: Hasta qué distancia las cosas mantienen su forma completa. Más alto se ve mejor y cuesta más.
How far away things keep their full shap.pt: Até que distância as coisas mantêm a forma completa. Mais alto fica mais bonito e custa mais.
How far away things keep their full shap.ja: どれだけ遠くまで物が本来の形を保つか。高いほどきれいですが、負荷が増えます。
How far away things keep their full shap.tr: Nesnelerin ne kadar uzakta tam şekillerini koruduğu. Daha yüksek daha iyi görünür ama daha çok yorar.
How far away things keep their full shap.fr: Jusqu'à quelle distance les objets gardent leur forme complète. Plus haut, c'est plus beau et plus coûteux.
How far away things keep their full shap.da: Hvor langt væk ting beholder deres fulde form. Højere ser bedre ud og koster mere.
How far away things keep their full shap.ru: На каком расстоянии предметы сохраняют полную форму. Выше — красивее, но тяжелее.
How far away things keep their full shap.pl: Z jakiej odległości rzeczy zachowują pełny kształt. Wyżej wygląda lepiej i więcej kosztuje.
How far away things keep their full shap.az: Əşyalar nə qədər uzaqdan tam formasını saxlayır. Yüksək olduqca gözəl, amma baha başa gəlir.
How far away things keep their full shap.de: Bis zu welcher Entfernung Dinge ihre volle Form behalten. Höher sieht besser aus und kostet mehr.
How far away things keep their full shap.zh-Hans: 多远的东西还保持完整形状。越高越好看，也越耗性能。

When things run slow, loading slows and._: settings menu: the tip on the 'load governor' row in the 'graphics' group of the view section; keep about as long as the English (the tip wraps to at most three lines of ~50 characters); plain, friendly sentences
When things run slow, loading slows and.zh: 執行變慢時，會暫時放慢載入並簡化遠處的東西，讓畫面保持流暢。
When things run slow, loading slows and.it: Quando tutto rallenta, il caricamento va più piano e le cose lontane si semplificano per un po', così la vista resta fluida.
When things run slow, loading slows and.es: Cuando todo va lento, la carga se frena y lo lejano se simplifica un rato, para que la vista siga fluida.
When things run slow, loading slows and.pt: Quando tudo fica lento, o carregamento desacelera e as coisas distantes ficam mais simples por um tempo, para a visão continuar fluida.
When things run slow, loading slows and.ja: 動作が重いとき、しばらく読み込みを遅くし、遠くの物を簡略化して、視界をなめらかに保ちます。
When things run slow, loading slows and.tr: İşler yavaşladığında, görüntü akıcı kalsın diye yükleme yavaşlar ve uzaktaki şeyler bir süre sadeleşir.
When things run slow, loading slows and.fr: Quand tout ralentit, le chargement ralentit et les objets lointains se simplifient un moment, pour garder une vue fluide.
When things run slow, loading slows and.da: Når det går langsomt, går indlæsningen langsommere, og fjerne ting forenkles et stykke tid, så udsynet forbliver jævnt.
When things run slow, loading slows and.ru: Когда всё тормозит, загрузка замедляется, а дальние предметы на время упрощаются, чтобы картинка оставалась плавной.
When things run slow, loading slows and.pl: Gdy wszystko zwalnia, wczytywanie zwalnia, a dalekie rzeczy na chwilę się upraszczają, by widok był płynny.
When things run slow, loading slows and.az: İş yavaşlayanda yükləmə yavaşıyır və uzaq şeylər bir müddət sadələşir ki, görüntü axıcı qalsın.
When things run slow, loading slows and.de: Läuft es langsam, lädt es eine Weile langsamer und Fernes wird einfacher, damit die Sicht flüssig bleibt.
When things run slow, loading slows and.zh-Hans: 运行变慢时，会暂时放慢加载并简化远处的东西，让画面保持流畅。

How many layers of glass, leaves and flo._: settings menu: the tip on the 'see-through layers' row in the 'graphics' group of the view section; keep about as long as the English (the tip wraps to at most three lines of ~50 characters); plain, friendly sentences
How many layers of glass, leaves and flo.zh: 前後重疊的玻璃、樹葉和花朵要描繪幾層。越少越快。
How many layers of glass, leaves and flo.it: Quanti strati di vetro, foglie e fiori vengono disegnati uno dietro l'altro. Meno è più veloce.
How many layers of glass, leaves and flo.es: Cuántas capas de cristal, hojas y flores se dibujan una tras otra. Menos es más rápido.
How many layers of glass, leaves and flo.pt: Quantas camadas de vidro, folhas e flores são desenhadas umas atrás das outras. Menos é mais rápido.
How many layers of glass, leaves and flo.ja: ガラスや葉、花を何層重ねて描くか。少ないほど速くなります。
How many layers of glass, leaves and flo.tr: Cam, yaprak ve çiçeklerin kaç katmanının üst üste çizildiği. Daha azı daha hızlıdır.
How many layers of glass, leaves and flo.fr: Combien de couches de verre, de feuilles et de fleurs sont dessinées les unes derrière les autres. Moins, c'est plus rapide.
How many layers of glass, leaves and flo.da: Hvor mange lag glas, blade og blomster der tegnes bag hinanden. Færre er hurtigere.
How many layers of glass, leaves and flo.ru: Сколько слоёв стекла, листьев и цветов рисуется друг за другом. Меньше — быстрее.
How many layers of glass, leaves and flo.pl: Ile warstw szkła, liści i kwiatów rysuje się jedna za drugą. Mniej to szybciej.
How many layers of glass, leaves and flo.az: Şüşə, yarpaq və çiçəklərin neçə qatı bir-birinin arxasında çəkilir. Az olduqca sürətli.
How many layers of glass, leaves and flo.de: Wie viele Schichten aus Glas, Blättern und Blüten hintereinander gezeichnet werden. Weniger ist schneller.
How many layers of glass, leaves and flo.zh-Hans: 前后重叠的玻璃、树叶和花朵要绘制几层。越少越快。

Glass and leaves lit fully, or more simp._: settings menu: the tip on the 'see-through light' row in the 'graphics' group of the view section; keep about as long as the English (the tip wraps to at most three lines of ~50 characters); plain, friendly sentences
Glass and leaves lit fully, or more simp.zh: 玻璃和樹葉以完整光照描繪，或用較簡單、較快的方式。
Glass and leaves lit fully, or more simp.it: Vetro e foglie illuminati del tutto, o in modo più semplice e veloce.
Glass and leaves lit fully, or more simp.es: Cristal y hojas con luz completa, o más simple y más rápido.
Glass and leaves lit fully, or more simp.pt: Vidro e folhas com iluminação total, ou mais simples e rápida.
Glass and leaves lit fully, or more simp.ja: ガラスや葉を完全に照らすか、簡易的に速く照らすか。
Glass and leaves lit fully, or more simp.tr: Cam ve yapraklar tam ya da daha basit ve hızlı aydınlatılır.
Glass and leaves lit fully, or more simp.fr: Verre et feuilles éclairés complètement, ou plus simplement et plus vite.
Glass and leaves lit fully, or more simp.da: Glas og blade belyst fuldt ud eller mere simpelt og hurtigere.
Glass and leaves lit fully, or more simp.ru: Стекло и листва освещаются полностью или проще и быстрее.
Glass and leaves lit fully, or more simp.pl: Szkło i liście oświetlone w pełni albo prościej i szybciej.
Glass and leaves lit fully, or more simp.az: Şüşə və yarpaqlar tam işıqlandırılır, ya da daha sadə və sürətli.
Glass and leaves lit fully, or more simp.de: Glas und Blätter voll beleuchtet, oder einfacher und schneller.
Glass and leaves lit fully, or more simp.zh-Hans: 玻璃和树叶用完整光照绘制，或用更简单、更快的方式。

Sun shadows and soft shading in corners._: settings menu: the tip on the 'shadow & ssao size' row in the 'graphics' group of the view section; keep about as long as the English (the tip wraps to at most three lines of ~50 characters); plain, friendly sentences; 'Half' is one of the row's options (full, half)
Sun shadows and soft shading in corners.zh: 以完整或一半的大小計算陽光陰影和角落的柔和陰影。一半較快，稍微柔和一些。
Sun shadows and soft shading in corners.it: Ombre del sole e ombreggiatura morbida negli angoli calcolate a dimensione piena o a metà. Metà è più veloce, un po' più morbida.
Sun shadows and soft shading in corners.es: Sombras del sol y sombreado suave en las esquinas calculados a tamaño total o a la mitad. Mitad es más rápido y algo más suave.
Sun shadows and soft shading in corners.pt: Sombras do sol e sombreado suave nos cantos calculados em tamanho total ou pela metade. Metade é mais rápido, um pouco mais suave.
Sun shadows and soft shading in corners.ja: 太陽の影と隅の柔らかな陰影を、フルサイズか半分のサイズで計算します。「半分」は速く、少し柔らかくなります。
Sun shadows and soft shading in corners.tr: Güneş gölgeleri ve köşelerdeki yumuşak gölgelendirme tam ya da yarım boyutta hesaplanır. Yarım daha hızlı, biraz daha yumuşaktır.
Sun shadows and soft shading in corners.fr: Ombres du soleil et ombrage doux des recoins calculés en taille pleine ou à moitié. Moitié est plus rapide, un peu plus doux.
Sun shadows and soft shading in corners.da: Solskygger og blød skygge i hjørner beregnet i fuld eller halv størrelse. Halv er hurtigere og lidt blødere.
Sun shadows and soft shading in corners.ru: Солнечные тени и мягкое затенение в углах считаются в полном или половинном размере. «Половина» быстрее и чуть мягче.
Sun shadows and soft shading in corners.pl: Cienie słońca i miękkie zacienienie w kątach liczone w pełnej lub połowie rozdzielczości. Połowa jest szybsza, nieco miększa.
Sun shadows and soft shading in corners.az: Günəş kölgələri və künclərdə yumşaq kölgələnmə tam və ya yarım ölçüdə hesablanır. Yarım daha sürətli, bir az yumşaqdır.
Sun shadows and soft shading in corners.de: Sonnenschatten und weiche Schattierung in Ecken in voller oder halber Größe berechnet. Halb ist schneller, etwas weicher.
Sun shadows and soft shading in corners.zh-Hans: 以完整或一半的尺寸计算阳光阴影和角落的柔和阴影。一半更快，稍微柔和一点。

Far shadows drawn a little larger so the._: settings menu: the tip on the 'far shadow margin' row in the 'graphics' group of the view section; keep about as long as the English (the tip wraps to at most three lines of ~50 characters); plain, friendly sentences
Far shadows drawn a little larger so the.zh: 遠處的陰影畫得稍大一些，讓你移動時可以重複使用。較快，遠處稍微柔和一些。
Far shadows drawn a little larger so the.it: Ombre lontane disegnate un po' più grandi per riusarle mentre ti muovi. Più veloce, un po' più morbido in lontananza.
Far shadows drawn a little larger so the.es: Sombras lejanas dibujadas algo más grandes para reutilizarlas mientras te mueves. Más rápido, algo más suave a lo lejos.
Far shadows drawn a little larger so the.pt: Sombras distantes desenhadas um pouco maiores para serem reaproveitadas enquanto você se move. Mais rápido, um pouco mais suave ao longe.
Far shadows drawn a little larger so the.ja: 遠くの影を少し大きめに描いて、移動中に使い回します。速くなり、遠くが少し柔らかくなります。
Far shadows drawn a little larger so the.tr: Uzak gölgeler, siz hareket ederken yeniden kullanılabilsin diye biraz daha geniş çizilir. Daha hızlı, uzakta biraz daha yumuşak.
Far shadows drawn a little larger so the.fr: Ombres lointaines dessinées un peu plus grandes pour être réutilisées pendant que vous bougez. Plus rapide, un peu plus doux au loin.
Far shadows drawn a little larger so the.da: Fjerne skygger tegnes lidt større, så de kan genbruges, mens du bevæger dig. Hurtigere, lidt blødere langt væk.
Far shadows drawn a little larger so the.ru: Дальние тени рисуются чуть крупнее, чтобы их можно было использовать повторно, пока вы двигаетесь. Быстрее, вдали чуть мягче.
Far shadows drawn a little larger so the.pl: Dalekie cienie rysowane nieco szerzej, by dało się ich używać ponownie podczas ruchu. Szybciej, w oddali nieco miękkie.
Far shadows drawn a little larger so the.az: Uzaq kölgələr bir az böyük çəkilir ki, hərəkət edərkən təkrar istifadə olunsun. Sürətli, uzaqda bir az yumşaq.
Far shadows drawn a little larger so the.de: Ferne Schatten etwas größer gezeichnet, damit sie beim Bewegen wiederverwendet werden. Schneller, in der Ferne etwas weicher.
Far shadows drawn a little larger so the.zh-Hans: 远处的阴影画得稍大一些，让你移动时可以重复使用。更快，远处稍微柔和一点。

Shadows carried on far away, softer, so._: settings menu: the tip on the 'far shadows' row in the 'graphics' group of the view section; keep about as long as the English (the tip wraps to at most three lines of ~50 characters); plain, friendly sentences; 'Off' is one of the row's options
Shadows carried on far away, softer, so.zh: 陰影延伸到遠處並變得柔和，不會在你周圍形成一圈後中斷。關：陰影像其他瀏覽器一樣在某處結束。
Shadows carried on far away, softer, so.it: Ombre che proseguono lontano, più morbide, così non si fermano in un anello intorno a te. No: finiscono come negli altri viewer.
Shadows carried on far away, softer, so.es: Sombras que siguen a lo lejos, más suaves, para que no acaben en un anillo a tu alrededor. No: terminan como en otros visores.
Shadows carried on far away, softer, so.pt: Sombras que continuam ao longe, mais suaves, para não pararem num anel ao seu redor. Não: terminam como nos outros visualizadores.
Shadows carried on far away, softer, so.ja: 遠くまで影を柔らかく続け、あなたの周りで輪のように途切れないようにします。オフ：他のビューアと同じく途中で終わります。
Shadows carried on far away, softer, so.tr: Gölgeler çevrenizde bir halka halinde bitmesin diye uzağa, daha yumuşak olarak taşınır. Kapalı: diğer görüntüleyicilerdeki gibi biter.
Shadows carried on far away, softer, so.fr: Les ombres continuent au loin, plus douces, pour ne pas s'arrêter en cercle autour de vous. Non : elles s'arrêtent comme dans les autres visionneuses.
Shadows carried on far away, softer, so.da: Skygger fortsætter langt væk, blødere, så de ikke stopper i en ring omkring dig. Fra: de slutter som i andre viewere.
Shadows carried on far away, softer, so.ru: Тени тянутся вдаль, мягче, чтобы не обрываться кольцом вокруг вас. «Выкл»: обрываются, как в других вьюверах.
Shadows carried on far away, softer, so.pl: Cienie sięgają daleko, miękciej, by nie kończyły się kręgiem wokół ciebie. Wył.: kończą się jak w innych przeglądarkach.
Shadows carried on far away, softer, so.az: Kölgələr uzağa qədər, yumşalaraq davam edir ki, ətrafınızda halqa kimi kəsilməsin. Bağlı: digər klientlərdəki kimi bitir.
Shadows carried on far away, softer, so.de: Schatten reichen weicher in die Ferne, statt in einem Ring um Sie zu enden. Aus: Sie enden wie in anderen Viewern.
Shadows carried on far away, softer, so.zh-Hans: 阴影延伸到远处并变得柔和，不会在你周围一圈处中断。关：和其他客户端一样在某处结束。

Skips shadows from tiny things. Faster,._: settings menu: the tip on the 'small shadow casters' row in the 'graphics' group of the view section; keep about as long as the English (the tip wraps to at most three lines of ~50 characters); plain, friendly sentences
Skips shadows from tiny things. Faster,.zh: 略過微小東西的陰影。較快，幾乎看不出差別。
Skips shadows from tiny things. Faster,.it: Salta le ombre delle cose minuscole. Più veloce, quasi senza differenze visibili.
Skips shadows from tiny things. Faster,.es: Omite las sombras de cosas diminutas. Más rápido, casi sin cambios visibles.
Skips shadows from tiny things. Faster,.pt: Pula as sombras de coisas minúsculas. Mais rápido, quase sem diferença visível.
Skips shadows from tiny things. Faster,.ja: とても小さな物の影を省きます。速くなり、見た目はほとんど変わりません。
Skips shadows from tiny things. Faster,.tr: Minik şeylerin gölgelerini atlar. Daha hızlı, fark edeceğiniz neredeyse hiçbir değişiklik olmadan.
Skips shadows from tiny things. Faster,.fr: Ignore les ombres des tout petits objets. Plus rapide, sans changement visible ou presque.
Skips shadows from tiny things. Faster,.da: Springer skygger fra bittesmå ting over. Hurtigere, næsten uden synlig forskel.
Skips shadows from tiny things. Faster,.ru: Пропускает тени от крошечных предметов. Быстрее, а разница почти незаметна.
Skips shadows from tiny things. Faster,.pl: Pomija cienie drobnych rzeczy. Szybciej, prawie bez widocznej zmiany.
Skips shadows from tiny things. Faster,.az: Kiçik şeylərin kölgələrini atlayır. Daha sürətli, fərqi demək olar ki, görünmür.
Skips shadows from tiny things. Faster,.de: Lässt Schatten winziger Dinge weg. Schneller, mit kaum sichtbarem Unterschied.
Skips shadows from tiny things. Faster,.zh-Hans: 跳过微小东西的阴影。更快，几乎看不出变化。

Narrow is lighter on the computer, with._: settings menu: the tip on the 'g-buffer (on restart)' row in the 'graphics' group of the view section; keep about as long as the English (the tip wraps to at most three lines of ~50 characters); plain, friendly sentences; 'Narrow' is one of the row's options (full, narrow); Sojourn is a name
Narrow is lighter on the computer, with.zh: 「精簡」對電腦負擔較輕，光亮的曲面會有些微變化。下次啟動 Sojourn 時生效。
Narrow is lighter on the computer, with.it: Ridotto pesa meno sul computer, con un lieve cambiamento sulle curve lucide. Vale dal prossimo avvio di Sojourn.
Narrow is lighter on the computer, with.es: Estrecho pesa menos al ordenador, con un leve cambio en curvas brillantes. Se aplica la próxima vez que se inicie Sojourn.
Narrow is lighter on the computer, with.pt: Estreito pesa menos no computador, com uma leve mudança em curvas brilhantes. Vale na próxima vez que o Sojourn iniciar.
Narrow is lighter on the computer, with.ja: 「縮小」はコンピューターの負担が軽く、光沢のある曲面がわずかに変わります。次にSojournを起動したときに適用されます。
Narrow is lighter on the computer, with.tr: Dar, bilgisayarı daha az yorar; parlak eğrilerde hafif bir değişiklik olur. Sojourn bir sonraki açılışında uygulanır.
Narrow is lighter on the computer, with.fr: Étroit est plus léger pour l'ordinateur, avec un léger changement sur les courbes brillantes. S'applique au prochain lancement de Sojourn.
Narrow is lighter on the computer, with.da: Smal er lettere for computeren, med en svag forskel på blanke kurver. Gælder, næste gang Sojourn starter.
Narrow is lighter on the computer, with.ru: «Узкий» легче для компьютера, с едва заметной разницей на блестящих изгибах. Действует со следующего запуска Sojourn.
Narrow is lighter on the computer, with.pl: Wąski mniej obciąża komputer, z lekką zmianą na błyszczących krzywiznach. Działa od następnego uruchomienia Sojourn.
Narrow is lighter on the computer, with.az: Dar kompüterə daha yüngüldür, parlaq əyrilərdə cüzi fərq olur. Sojourn növbəti dəfə başlayanda tətbiq olunur.
Narrow is lighter on the computer, with.de: Schmal schont den Computer, mit leichtem Unterschied an glänzenden Rundungen. Gilt beim nächsten Start von Sojourn.
Narrow is lighter on the computer, with.zh-Hans: “精简”对电脑负担更轻，光亮的曲面会有细微变化。下次启动 Sojourn 时生效。

How sharp the view is drawn. Auto follow._: settings menu: the tip on the 'resolution' row in the 'graphics' group of the view section; keep about as long as the English (the tip wraps to at most three lines of ~50 characters); plain, friendly sentences; 'Auto' is the row's value at its lowest step
How sharp the view is drawn. Auto follow.zh: 畫面描繪的清晰度。「自動」會配合電腦能負荷的程度。
How sharp the view is drawn. Auto follow.it: Quanto è nitida la vista. Auto segue ciò che il computer riesce a reggere.
How sharp the view is drawn. Auto follow.es: Lo nítida que se dibuja la vista. Auto sigue lo que el ordenador puede mantener.
How sharp the view is drawn. Auto follow.pt: O quanto a visão é nítida. Auto acompanha o que o computador consegue aguentar.
How sharp the view is drawn. Auto follow.ja: 描画の鮮明さ。「自動」はコンピューターが追いつける解像度に合わせます。
How sharp the view is drawn. Auto follow.tr: Görüntünün ne kadar keskin çizildiği. Oto, bilgisayarın yetişebildiğine uyar.
How sharp the view is drawn. Auto follow.fr: La netteté du rendu de la vue. Auto suit ce que l'ordinateur arrive à tenir.
How sharp the view is drawn. Auto follow.da: Hvor skarpt udsynet tegnes. Auto følger det, computeren kan følge med til.
How sharp the view is drawn. Auto follow.ru: Насколько чётко рисуется картинка. «Авто» подстраивается под то, что тянет компьютер.
How sharp the view is drawn. Auto follow.pl: Jak ostro rysowany jest widok. Auto dopasowuje się do możliwości komputera.
How sharp the view is drawn. Auto follow.az: Görüntü nə qədər kəskin çəkilir. Avto: kompüterin çatdıra bildiyinə uyğunlaşır.
How sharp the view is drawn. Auto follow.de: Wie scharf die Sicht gezeichnet wird. „auto“ richtet sich danach, was der Computer schafft.
How sharp the view is drawn. Auto follow.zh-Hans: 画面绘制的清晰度。“自动”会配合电脑跟得上的程度。

When a picture is late, the headset uses._: settings menu: the tip on the 'depth reprojection' row in the 'graphics' group of the view section; keep about as long as the English (the tip wraps to at most three lines of ~50 characters); plain, friendly sentences
When a picture is late, the headset uses.zh: 畫面來不及時，頭戴裝置會利用深度，在你移動時更準確地位移上一幀畫面。
When a picture is late, the headset uses.it: Quando un'immagine è in ritardo, il visore usa la profondità per spostare l'ultima con più precisione mentre ti muovi.
When a picture is late, the headset uses.es: Cuando una imagen llega tarde, las gafas usan la profundidad para desplazar la anterior con más precisión al moverte.
When a picture is late, the headset uses.pt: Quando uma imagem atrasa, o headset usa a profundidade para deslocar a anterior com mais precisão enquanto você se move.
When a picture is late, the headset uses.ja: 画像が遅れたとき、ヘッドセットが深度を使って、直前の画像を動きに合わせてより正確にずらします。
When a picture is late, the headset uses.tr: Bir kare geciktiğinde VR gözlüğü, siz hareket ederken sonuncuyu derinlik bilgisiyle daha doğru kaydırır.
When a picture is late, the headset uses.fr: Quand une image est en retard, le casque utilise la profondeur pour décaler la précédente plus précisément pendant que vous bougez.
When a picture is late, the headset uses.da: Når et billede er forsinket, bruger headsettet dybde til at flytte det forrige mere præcist, mens du bevæger dig.
When a picture is late, the headset uses.ru: Когда кадр опаздывает, шлем по глубине точнее сдвигает предыдущий, пока вы двигаетесь.
When a picture is late, the headset uses.pl: Gdy klatka się spóźnia, gogle używają głębi, by dokładniej przesunąć poprzednią, gdy się ruszasz.
When a picture is late, the headset uses.az: Kadr gecikəndə VR eynəyi dərinlikdən istifadə edərək sonuncunu hərəkətinizə görə daha dəqiq sürüşdürür.
When a picture is late, the headset uses.de: Kommt ein Bild zu spät, verschiebt das Headset das letzte mithilfe der Tiefe genauer, während Sie sich bewegen.

How many of the nearest avatars are draw.es: Cuántos de los avatares más cercanos se dibujan enteros. El resto son sustitutos más ligeros.

How many of the nearest avatars are draw.fr: Combien des avatars les plus proches sont dessinés en entier. Les autres sont remplacés par des formes plus légères.
How many of the nearest avatars are draw.da: Hvor mange af de nærmeste avatarer der tegnes helt. Resten er lettere stedfortrædere.

Avatars heavier than this show as plain._: settings menu: the tip on the 'complexity limit' row in the 'avatars' group of the view section; keep about as long as the English (the tip wraps to at most three lines of ~50 characters); plain, friendly sentences
Avatars heavier than this show as plain.zh: 超過這個複雜度的化身會以簡單形狀顯示，以保持流暢。

Avatars heavier than this show as plain.ja: これより重いアバターは単純な形で表示し、動作をなめらかに保ちます。
Avatars heavier than this show as plain.tr: Bundan ağır avatarlar, işler akıcı kalsın diye düz şekiller olarak görünür.

Avatars heavier than this show as plain.ru: Аватары сложнее этого показываются простыми формами, чтобы всё шло плавно.
Avatars heavier than this show as plain.pl: Awatary cięższe niż to widać jako proste kształty, by wszystko było płynne.
Avatars heavier than this show as plain.az: Bundan ağır avatarlar sadə fiqur kimi görünür ki, görüntü axıcı qalsın.
Avatars heavier than this show as plain.de: Komplexere Avatare erscheinen als schlichte Formen, damit alles flüssig bleibt.
Avatars heavier than this show as plain.zh-Hans: 比这更复杂的化身会以简单形状显示，以保持流畅。

People's mouths move when they speak by._: settings menu: the tip on the 'lip sync' row in the 'avatars' group of the view section; keep about as long as the English (the tip wraps to at most three lines of ~50 characters); plain, friendly sentences

People's mouths move when they speak by.de: Die Münder der Leute bewegen sich, wenn sie per Voice sprechen.

Moves the sun earlier or later, just for._: settings menu: the tip on the 'time of day' row in the view section; keep about as long as the English (the tip wraps to at most three lines of ~50 characters); plain, friendly sentences; 'the sky' is the sky row above it (pressing its option again)

Where you are, above your left wrist, wi._: settings menu: the tip on the 'location line' row in the view section; keep about as long as the English (the tip wraps to at most three lines of ~50 characters); plain, friendly sentences
